detailed_descriptions.en: Xanthiom 2 is an action-adventure platforming game in which you explore a massive planet and fight its hostile inhabitants! Play as Captain Grisham as you explore what remains of Earth, after humanity's last war! Combat all manner of deadly enemies, from sentient war machines to biological experiments gone wrong! Discover powerful weapons and abilities to assist you on your journey to avenge humanity! Also featuring: Xanthiom Zero ReSimulated is a from-the-ground-up remake of Xanthiom Zero, which is included with Xanthiom 2! After the events of Xanthiom Zero, the Coalition commissioned a team of elite computer scientists to create a perfect simulation of planet 4-514. It is your job to explore the simulation and discover what Captain Grisham is keeping from the Coalition!
